sources.title: Model-Based Diffusion for Trajectory Optimization
sources.review_notes: All 30 pages reviewed against page renders by three reviewer agents (reports/review-pages-0001-0010.md, -0011-0020.md, -0021-0030.md): equations (1a)-(32) and the unnumbered ones transcribed to LaTeX and compared with 200-300 dpi crops, 9 figures, 8 tables (cell by cell against native text) and 3 algorithm boxes checked by crops, references [1]-[64] one entry per item, the 15 checklist items kept as text. Verifier diagnostics on pages with mathematics are LaTeX-notation, minus-glyph and algorithm-transcription differences, adjudicated per page.
